title: Transfer CT landmarks across real respiratory deformation
hypothesis: Real intra-patient respiratory shape change removes the global rigid/affine solution and may expose correspondence reasoning failures even when nominal acquisition geometry and standard registration libraries are available.
why_hard: Stable difficulty is not established. The original BR-021 2D miss (12.641 mm RMS) was followed by two predeclared fresh Terra/high attempts: normal failure at 24.905 mm RMS and normal pass at 2.021 mm RMS. Exact replay and controlled interventions show that the original composition bug is secondary: repairing it leaves 12.410 mm RMS error. Search bounds exclude one target, and small-patch similarity favors some wrong matches. Larger context rescues both author patch models, while the passing agent uses broader candidate search and visual/stability checks with small numerical patches. A separately requested fresh Sol/xhigh attempt also passes: 1.563 mm RMS / 3.667 mm maximum. Its exact final-stage replay and four fixed component interventions identify q04 initialization as decisive under the final optimizer; final multiscale polishing is unnecessary after its earlier matching work.
next_action: Retire this exact 2D snapshot as a reliably difficult Terra candidate under the pass-retirement rule, preserving the original miss, fresh mixed outcomes and all counterfactuals as diagnostic evidence. The 3D snapshot remains retired. Any multi-patient replication or new difficulty condition requires a separately authorized, frozen study; none is scheduled.

notes: One selected inhale/exhale case and eight sparse correspondences; known source frame isolates deformation. Engineering tolerances are 3 mm RMS and 5 mm maximum, not clinical acceptance. Fresh replications receive no earlier code, hints, answers or author analysis. Controls, hashes, runtime contexts and independent regrading agree. Both fresh agents use installed SimpleITK and own numerical code; no external download or annotation lookup is observed. Public-label training contamination cannot be excluded. Label-assisted geometric/objective diagnostics remain explicitly separate from public-input solvers. The author context contrast is not a one-line repair of the agent pipeline. Original BR-019/020/021 freezes, historical results, the closed report and sibling submission remain unchanged. Sol uses its own NumPy/SciPy matching and recorded image/neighborhood checks, without observed external solver downloads. Its conditional final-stage interventions do not isolate the separate upstream effects of regression, visual inspection and revised search bounds. One Sol/xhigh versus Terra/high traces is not a controlled model ranking.
